thesis_tokens.label: Air-gapped data residency demand
thesis_tokens.limitation: YC interest does not establish paid demand for HumanAIOS.

thesis_tokens.label: Behavioral evidence layer for institutions
thesis_tokens.limitation: Audit receipts do not by themselves prove correctness or legal compliance.

thesis_tokens.label: Narrow paid institutional pilot
thesis_tokens.limitation: No customer, signed contract, or revenue is established.

thesis_tokens.label: Physical data-center supply chain
thesis_tokens.limitation: YC sector signal only; HumanAIOS physical supply capability not established. Defer.

thesis_tokens.label: Privacy, non-surveillance, and honest communication
thesis_tokens.limitation: Public hostility has not been measured. Low-profile does not mean hidden accountability.

thesis_tokens.label: Regulatory certification and commercial moat
thesis_tokens.limitation: FedRAMP scope is deployment-specific. No certification or moat established.

thesis_tokens.label: Customer-owned local intelligence
thesis_tokens.limitation: Local model health checks do not prove zero egress.

needs.label: Keep sensitive data under operator control
needs.statement: Show zero-egress on a bounded local synthetic workflow.

needs.label: Reconstruct and challenge machine decisions
needs.statement: Keep P1 original, P2 challenge, P3 correction, human decision and source receipt distinct.

needs.label: Reduce worker burden without surveillance
needs.statement: Make machine proposals understandable, contestable and revocable.

needs.label: Prove institutional demand before expansion
needs.statement: Seek independent review and paid pilot evidence; do not infer sales from listings.

capabilities.label: Source-bound Witness chain and retained P1
Measured human utility and commercial proof

controlled_resources.label: Existing Resource Miner planning and discovery
Typed INTENT-OS contract in open draft

resource_requirements.label: Independent local zero-egress observation
resource_requirements.objective: Pin a synthetic workload and record allowed and blocked egress; do not infer isolation from local inference.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Observer independently verifies no outbound payload and test negative control.

resource_requirements.label: Immutable proposal, challenge, correction and human decision
resource_requirements.objective: Reject forged receipts or unauthorized actors while retaining original P1.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Independent reference checks demonstrate reconstruction and fail-closed authorization.

resource_requirements.label: Independent human outcome evaluation
resource_requirements.objective: Compare matched synthetic admin case versus manual checklist, human comprehension and errors.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Independent reviewer documents error, time, corrections and burden against baseline.

resource_requirements.label: Institutional buyer or paid pilot discovery
resource_requirements.objective: Locate consented authorized operator or procurement channel. Listing is not an acquired customer.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Document authorized buyer feedback, agreement, or rejection.

resource_requirements.label: Dedicated air-gap hardware, only if non-substitutable
resource_requirements.objective: Do not buy hardware unless existing tools fail the isolated experiment.

resource_requirements.label: Qualified deployment-specific regulatory review
resource_requirements.objective: Determine exact data types, deployment, scope and competent authorizer; no certification claim.
resource_requirements.satisfied_when: Qualified reviewer records scoped obligation and required evidence.

substitution_assessments.rationale: Local-model pilot is not independent zero-egress proof.
Design controls are not an independently tested institutional runtime.
Internal design does not replace independent human study.
